copy.curiosityHook: When a disastrous accident leaves two climbers stranded high in the remote Andes, impossible choices dictate whether either man can make it down alive.
copy.description: In 1985, mountaineers Joe Simpson and Simon Yates take on the perilous 6,344-meter Siula Grande in the Peruvian Andes, setting off a climbing expedition that rapidly spirals into a nearly fatal catastrophe.
copy.vibeSummary: Tense, emotionally heavy mountaineering survival that demands focused attention and delivers steady, visceral suspense.
copy.whyWatch: Director Kevin Macdonald reconstructs a harrowing true survival story with documentary precision and dramatic weight, capturing extreme risk at the edge of endurance.
